core_statement: Every crystal packet has native quantity exactly 1 in every declared dimension and precision layer. Dimension is relational, not a packet weight. Every adjacency transition event contributes exactly 1 to path count. Geometry is downstream.

axioms.rule: For every crystal packet x in every declared carrier/dimension/precision layer, UNIT_PACKET(x)=1.
Dimension may be represented by adjacency/incidence/channel/stacking/refinement/symmetry relations; it never changes the native quantity of an individual packet from 1.
For a finite occupied packet set C, OCCUPIED_PACKET_COUNT(C)=|C|. Effective area, volume, or d-content names are downstream readouts of this count plus carrier/precision semantics.
The minimal local relation required for path is adjacency; line, distance, length, edge, boundary, perimeter, chord, angle, curvature, radius, area, and volume are not N0 primitives.
For every actual transition x->y across declared adjacency, TRANSITION_COUNT increments by exactly 1. A path with n transitions has PATH_COUNT=n.
Paths permit revisits, loops, immediate reversal, same-adjacency reuse, and arbitrary allowed channel reuse. No simplicity, shortestness, straightness, or geodesicity is assumed.
Packet/occupancy count is a static object count; transition/path count is a dynamic event count. Revisits may increase transition count without increasing occupied packet count.
Every packet at every precision layer remains quantity 1. Refinement changes the packet count and relation language; it does not assign native 1/r weights to finer packets.

External/decorative packet shape does not alter UNIT_PACKET=1. Shape matters only through explicitly admitted relational changes such as adjacency, channel incidence, symmetry, stacking, or refinement.

Finite channel states are carrier-specific additional relational structure. In an ideal C6 carrier, ingress I_x[0..5], egress O_x[0..5], and passage M_x[a,b] may be counted, including same-channel ingress/egress. No geometric turn/straight/angle semantics is inherited.
Area and volume are effective readout names, not native primitives. The shared native source is packet count, not powers of a prior length.
PATH_COUNT is not geometric length. Distance, displacement magnitude, shortestness, straightness, line, metric and geodesic structure remain undefined at N0 until separately derived.
